effects.name: Proof Against Disease
effects.tooltip: Proof Against Disease +8 : This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +8 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 9 + their Fortitude save).

effects.name: Immunity to Fear
effects.tooltip: Immunity to Fear : The wearer of this item is immune to all fear effects.

effects.name: Fearsome
effects.tooltip: Fearsome : This item causes those who strike the user to be overcome with terror, as from the Fear spell .
